first_page_excerpt: 1SLVUBE4 – March 2018 Submit Documentation Feedback Copyright © 2018, Texas Instruments Incorporated TPS6282xEVM-794 Evaluation Module User's Guide SLVUBE4 – March 2018 TPS6282xEVM-794 Evaluation Module The TPS6282xEVM-794 facilitates the evaluation of the TPS62825 and TPS62826 2-A and 3-A pin-to-pin compatible step-down converters with DCS-Control™ in a 1.5-mm × 1.5-mm QFN package. The PWR794- 001 uses the 2-A TPS62825, and the PWR794-002 uses the 3-A TPS62826. The EVMs output a 1.8-V output voltage with 1% accuracy from input voltages from 2.4 V to 5.5 V with a maximum solution height of 1 mm. The TPS62825 and TPS62826 are highly efficient and small solutions for point-of-load (POL) converters in all types of equipment, such as solid-state drives (SSDs), optical modules, and portable devices.
